listings.thesis: Direct proxy for one of the biggest current human-goods lines: pharmaceutical and medical-product consumption.
listings.note: Defensive consumption proxy, but lower alpha because the basket is consensus, mature, and already institutionally owned.

priorCase.rankRationale: Silicon-consumption-vs-human-goods lens: LLY is the human/pharma-consumption proxy. The June 8 ACHIEVE data was already captured in the June 9 case; no new evidence after June 9. On this alpha-weighted page LLY remains the definition of consensus ($984B cap, fully owned), so rank 8 holds with no further drift.
